schemes.name: SIIP 2024 SGST reimbursement (75% of SGST paid in cash, 10 years)
schemes.notes: Keys of rate_by_zone are ENTERPRISE CATEGORIES, not zones (no zoning in this policy). Reimbursement = up to 75% of SGST paid through electronic cash ledger (s.49(1) Sikkim GST Act) on finished products for 10 years from commercial production; total capped at 250% (micro) / 200% (small) / 150% (medium & large) of Fixed Capital Investment. New units only (para 12.1), not in negative list Annexure I; must register under SIIP and start production within 18 months of registration; continue production >=75% of preceding 5-yr average for next 5 years or refund. Subject to State budget allocation. Policy valid 10 years from date of Government Order (GO number/date not printed in the published PDF; PDF dated Sep 2024).

other_benefits: Stamp duty: 50% reimbursement/exemption up to Rs 25 lakh; women entrepreneurs 100% up to Rs 50 lakh (para 11.2.1).
Patents: actual cost up to Rs 2 lakh domestic / Rs 10 lakh international, max 5 per company (para 11.2.2).
Frontier Economic Zones (Mangan, Soreng, Gyalshing, Namchi districts): free government-land lease rental for first 5 years (para 11.2.3).

Para 11.2 lists power subsidy, technology transfer & quality certification, SME-exchange listing and environmental compliance assistance as 'other incentives' (aggregate <=100% of FCI) but gives NO rates or caps.
unverifiable: No state capital investment subsidy or interest subsidy in SIIP 2024; capital/interest support for Sikkim comes from central UNNATI 2024 (see central-ne.json; Gangtok & Pakyong = Zone A, other districts Zone B).
Government Order number/date for SIIP 2024 not found (not printed in either official PDF copy); hence valid_from/valid_to unknown (10 years from GO date).
Power subsidy and quality-certification reimbursement rates not specified in the policy text; no operational guidelines found on industries.sikkim.gov.in.
A secondary ICAI summary mentions a 'Sikkim MSME Policy 2022' with 20% capital subsidy / 25% interest subsidy; no official document found, not included.
